name: Filikod – ALT Text & Image Resizing
author: Filikod

sections.description:
Images are often the messiest part of a WordPress site.

Missing ALT text, oversized images, unsafe SVG uploads, useless title attributes…
Most sites accumulate these issues over time especially older ones.

Filikod fixes that automatically.

Filikod is a lightweight WordPress plugin focused on media hygiene, SEO, and accessibility.
It helps you clean and optimize your image library without spending hours editing images one by one.

Filikod does not try to be another heavy image compression plugin.
Instead, it focuses on what really slows people down:

  • Automatically generating and cleaning ALT text
  • Resizing images to proper dimensions
  • Cleaning media metadata
  • Securing SVG uploads
  • Managing additional file types safely

No complex setup.
Activate it, configure it once, and let it work.

Learn more about Filikod, documentation, and future features:
Learn more on Filikod.com

What Filikod Solves

  • You don’t want to fill ALT text manually for every image
  • You inherit WordPress sites with hundreds of images and no ALT
  • Your media library is bloated with oversized images
  • You need SVG uploads without security risks
  • You want a simple, lightweight tool not a factory of options

Filikod is built for site owners, freelancers, and agencies who want clean media, fast.

Features

ALT Text Automation & Cleanup

Stop managing ALT text by hand.

  • Automatically generate missing ALT text based on file names
  • Bulk scan and regenerate ALT text for existing images
  • Clean special characters for readable, SEO-friendly ALT attributes
  • Remove redundant title attributes for better accessibility

Perfect for fixing old WordPress sites with poor media SEO.

Image Resizing (Upload + Bulk)

Serve images at the right size without compression tricks.

  • Automatic image resizing on upload (configurable max width)
  • Bulk resizing for images already in the Media Library
  • Replaces original files to save disk space
  • Keeps WordPress metadata intact

Filikod resizes images but does not compress them.

Secure SVG Upload

Use SVG files safely in WordPress.

  • Secure SVG upload activation
  • File extension and MIME type validation
  • SVG XML sanitization
  • Automatic removal of unsafe tags (script, iframe, etc.)

Extended File Type Support

Need more than standard WordPress file types?

  • Enable or disable additional formats:
    SVGZ, PSD, AI, EPS, ICO, ZIP, RAR, 7Z, WEBM
  • Simple toggle-based configuration

Dashboard & Admin Interface

Understand your media at a glance.

  • Media dashboard with total images, media size, ALT coverage, and resize ratio
  • Clean, tab-based interface
  • AJAX bulk processing to avoid timeouts
  • Fully multisite compatible

Compatibility

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • Compatible with all themes
  • Works with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, WPBakery, and other page builders
  • Compatible with GD and Imagick
  • Multisite ready
sections.installation:
1. Install Filikod from the WordPress plugin directory
  2. Activate it from the “Plugins” menu
  3. Go to Filikod > Settings to configure options

Filikod automatically resizes newly uploaded images.
Bulk tools allow you to clean and optimize existing images in the Media Library.
sections.faq:
Does Filikod replace my original images?

Yes. When resizing is enabled, the original image is replaced with the resized version to save disk space. WordPress metadata remains intact.

Is Filikod compatible with page builders?

Yes. Optimized images work everywhere, including Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, WPBakery, and others.

Can I optimize existing images?

Yes. Filikod includes bulk tools to resize images and clean or regenerate ALT text for existing media.

Can I use Filikod with other optimization plugins?

Yes, as long as they are not performing the same resizing actions. Use only one resizing plugin at a time.

Does Filikod support WebP or AVIF?

Not yet. WebP and AVIF conversion are planned for a future premium version.

Where can I find documentation or support?

Documentation and support are available at:
Filikod.com
